metadata.description: Custom Claude Code plugins and skills

plugins.name: deckling
plugins.description: Generate professional PPTX presentations using Anthropic Platform Skills API

plugins.name: mvp-launch
plugins.description: Web app MVP launch readiness checker. Analyzes existing codebases against a battle-tested 10-point checklist (Stripe, mobile, onboarding, AI stability, emails, logging, feedback, auth, domain, database) via /launch-check.

plugins.name: product-management
plugins.description: AI-native product management for startups with WINNING filter, gap analysis, competitor research, and GitHub Issues integration

plugins.name: rethink-surveys
plugins.description: Survey design framework grounded in Caroline Jarrett, Dillman, and Tourangeau methods. Captures real intent (past behavior, not hypotheticals) via multimodal flows (text/voice/AI-interviewer). Includes 3 use-case templates (event organizers, startup founders, gig workers) and commands for design, critique, and app-scaffold generation.

plugins.name: ccc-skills
plugins.description: Collection of skills and commands: Excalidraw diagrams, Streak challenge tracker, agentic system design, self-improving systems, htmldrop HTML sharing, landing page GTM, UAT testing, and cross-app shared auth
